name: Kinetic Proficiency, Defensive
body:
Prerequisite(s): Kinetic Proficiency, Defensive Combat Training.

Benefit(s): When you ready an infusion which can be used as part of an attack action (such as devastating infusion or kinetic blade), the attack has the blocking and bracing weapon qualities. When this infusion is readied against a charge, you can make one 5-foot step as a free action when it is triggered.
